<stasis/>Shattering a <stasis/>Frozen enemy creates a <stasis/>Stasis Seeker that targets the closest enemy within a 12 meter radius. 

Seekers detonate in a <pve 3 /> <pvp [1.75] /> meter radius upon reaching their target, <stasis/>Freezing all enemies hit.

Iceflare Bolts incur an 8 second cooldown upon creating <pve 7 /> <pvp [1] /> Seekers within ? seconds of each other.
